description:
Store DNS provider credentials for automated domain verification. Note: credentials will be visible in the AI conversation context.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account, signed in: call start_login, show the user its challenge, then wait_for_login, then call this tool again. Authenticating this client alone does NOT open this tool.

provider.description: DNS provider identifier (e.g. cloudflare, route53, digitalocean)

name: create_dns_credential

outputSchema.description: A saved DNS provider credential. The secret is never returned.

last_used_at.description: When the credential last made a DNS change; absent until it has. Sent by the list only.

last_validated_at.description: When the credential was last checked against its provider; absent when never recorded. Sent by the list only.

validation_error.description: Why the last check refused the credential; absent unless one did. Sent by the list only.
